crossRefs.note: Even the jackals offer their breast. They nurse their young ones. But the daughter of my people has become cruel, like…
“Look, Yahweh, and see to whom you have done thus! Should the women eat their offspring, the children that they held…
As the king of Israel was passing by on the wall, a woman cried to him, saying, “Help, my lord, O king!”
“Can a woman forget her nursing child, that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? Yes, these may…
My eye runs down with streams of water, for the destruction of the daughter of my people.
The tender and delicate woman among you, who would not venture to set the sole of her foot on the ground for…
toward her young one who comes out from between her feet, and toward her children whom she bears; for she will eat them…
So we boiled my son, and ate him: and I said to her on the next day, ‘Give your son, that we may eat him;’ and she has…

translations.web: The hands of the pitiful women have boiled their own children. They were their food in the destruction of the daughter of my people.
translations.bsb: The hands of compassionate women have cooked their own children, who became their food in the destruction of the daughter of my people.
translations.kjv: The hands of the pitiful women have sodden their own children: they were their meat in the destruction of the daughter of my people.
translations.asv: The hands of the pitiful women have boiled their own children; They were their food in the destruction of the daughter of my people.
